name: ScrollArea
title: Scroll Area
description: A container with custom scrollbars for overflow content.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
import { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root>, "children" | "child"> & {
	class?: string;
	children?: Snippet;
};

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root bind:ref data-slot="scroll-area" class={cn("cn-scroll-area", className)} {...rest}>
	{@render children?.()}
</ScrollAreaPrimitive.Root>

<script lang="ts">
import { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Corner>, "child">;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ScrollAreaPrimitive.Corner
	bind:ref
	data-slot="scroll-area-corner"
	class={cn("cn-scroll-area-corner", className)}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</ScrollAreaPrimitive.Corner>

<script lang="ts">
import { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Scrollbar>, "child">;
let {
	ref = $bindable(null),
	orientation = "vertical",
	class: className = "",
	children,
	...rest
}: Props = $props();
</script>

<ScrollAreaPrimitive.Scrollbar
	bind:ref
	data-slot="scroll-area-scrollbar"
	class={cn("cn-scroll-area-scrollbar", className)}
	{orientation}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</ScrollAreaPrimitive.Scrollbar>

<script lang="ts">
import { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Thumb>, "child">;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ScrollAreaPrimitive.Thumb
	bind:ref
	data-slot="scroll-area-thumb"
	class={cn("cn-scroll-area-thumb", className)}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</ScrollAreaPrimitive.Thumb>

<script lang="ts">
import { ScrollArea as ScrollAreaPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport>, "child">;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport
	bind:ref
	data-slot="scroll-area-viewport"
	class={cn("cn-scroll-area-viewport", className)}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</ScrollAreaPrimitive.Viewport>
